out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Observed changes in equipment for the addition of a new fryer, rice cooker, and new griddle installed under the cookline. Additional hose sprayers were installed in ventilation hood.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: Fryer, Rice cooker, griddle.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: Guacamole (45F) observed in 3 Dr UR after 6hours, Guacamole (45F) observed in walk in cooler after 6hrs.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). Items discarded.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Queso observed at 125F in the main service line and 130F in the to go service line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Queso taken to range to reheat and return to the line.
